title: Administration
description: Manage users, roles and global panel settings.

users.title: Panel Users
users.description: Manage user accounts and their roles.

roles.title: Panel Roles
roles.description: Manage roles and their permission sets.
roles.deleteDescription: This action is irreversible. Make sure this role is not assigned to any user.

userForm.createDescription: Fill in the data to create a new account.
userForm.newPassword: New password (leave empty to keep current)

validation.passwordRequired: Password (min. 4 characters) is required for new user.
validation.passwordMinLength: New password must be at least 4 characters.

roleForm.description: Specify role name and select available permissions.

settings.title: Global Settings
settings.description: These settings affect the entire panel. Network access changes require a restart.
settings.restartDescription: Discord Rich Presence settings apply immediately. Restarting the panel (e.g. via start.bat or node backend/cli.js) is only required when changing External Access.
settings.externalAccessDescription: Allow panel access from local network or internet.
settings.telemetryDescription: Send anonymous statistics (bot count, plugins) to improve the project.

discordRpc.title: Discord Status (Rich Presence)
discordRpc.description: Displays your panel activity, current section, running bot count, and a Telegram link button on your Discord profile.
discordRpc.reconnectAttempted: Connection requested. Make sure the desktop Discord client is running.
discordRpc.reconnectError: Failed to reconnect Discord Rich Presence.
discordRpc.enableDescription: Show MineDash status on your Discord profile on this computer.
discordRpc.showSectionDescription: Display which tab or bot page you are currently viewing.
discordRpc.showBotCountDescription: Display a line with active and total bots.
